For Pat’s 10-mile endurance run, the music should feature a steady, consistent BPM (beats per minute) to help her maintain a rhythmic stride and enter a meditative flow. Since she is running long distances, high-energy, chaotic tracks might be distracting. Instead, select genres like ambient electronic, progressive house, or steady drum-and-bass with a tempo between 120-140 BPM. These selections provide the necessary driving rhythm without overwhelming her focus, allowing her to stay in the zone for the duration of the run.
